text:
Maya Patel: Ok team — planning Q2 PLG experiment focused on developer communities + partner pilot. Need alignment on seller targets, launch criteria, and enablement.
Jamal Brooks: high level ask: sales needs a target to commit reps. thinking 40 enterprise-qualified trials from pilot cohort in 8 weeks. doable? :thinking_face:
Lena Ortiz: product perspective: we can support a lightweight onboarding funnel + two short templates. Timeline wise we can ship the templates + analytics hook by week 3.
Samir Venkatar: can we measure activation as 'first successful API call + embedding index created'? that's our most reliable signal.
Ari Chen: devex can prep a guided quickstart repo, 3-min demo gif, and a sandbox token rotation snippet. ETA end of week 2.
Maya Patel: launch criteria proposal: (1) onboarding docs + 3 demos live, (2) tracking events for activation in prod, (3) playbook for sellers + 1 enablement session booked, (4) committed partner(s) for pilot.
Jamal Brooks: agree but add a commercial gate: at least 2 pilot logos with verbal buy-in and a shared success metric (cost/per-1k-tokens improvement goal). reps won't push without that.
Lena Ortiz: scope negotiation: we will not support custom quantization profiles for pilot — that'll be post-launch. Keep model variants to standard + small-quant. Saves infra time.
Samir Venkatar: analytics snippet we want in the repo:
```
trackEvent('plg_activation', {user_id, org_id, first_success_ts, model_variant})
```
Maya Patel: perfect. I'll draft the seller one-pager and the enablement slide deck. Jamal, can you confirm seller attendees for the enablement call? ideally 6 reps.
Jamal Brooks: I'll confirm headcount by EOD. also want a short objection-handling doc for pricing asks.
Ari Chen: putting sandbox + quickstart in GH -> link tomorrow. will add README with known limitations.
GTMbot: Reminder: add 'pilot' tag to all campaign tracking UTM params. See docs: https://redwood.internal/gtm/utm
Maya Patel: next steps: I'll finish playbook draft + landing page copy by Wed, Lena will unblock templates, Samir will wire tracking, Ari will push quickstart. If all gates green, target soft-launch next Monday.
Lena Ortiz: noted. pulling in engineering to help with analytics endpoint tomorrow morning.
Jamal Brooks: thumbs up. If we hit 40 trials in 8 weeks we escalate to reserved capacity discussion.
Maya Patel: thanks all — will follow up with a short Loom and the checklist.
